title: Private VPC Security Rollout: RBAC, Audit Trails & KMS Enablement — Coordination and Enablement
creator: Aisha Malik
description:
Goal: Coordinate a low-friction release and enablement for the Private/VPC on-prem security primitives scheduled for private-2025.12. This ticket covers cross-functional release coordination for RBAC (role templates + API), immutable audit trails (server-side event export + UI viewer), and KMS integrations (customer KMS onboarding + migration guidance).

Scope: delivery of consolidated release notes, public and internal docs, support runbooks, sales/CS enablement materials, console UX copy updates, SDK/CLI compatibility notes, and compliance artifact packaging (SOC/ISO checklist updates). Also includes gating criteria for production rollout (canary pass rate, upgrade playbook validation, security sign-off).

Outcomes expected:
- Complete, deployable release notes and migration guide for customers using private deployments.
- Support and SRE runbooks with triage flows for RBAC and KMS incidents.
- Sales/CS enablement deck and one-pagers for GTM.
- Legal & compliance sign-off on audit log retention and KMS key handling documentation.
- Dashboard updates for observability and telemetry to surface adoption and regressions post-rollout.

Add telemetry events and SLO checks for canary evaluation - responsible: Observability
